title: Quasi-finite compact support is exact and agrees with compactifications
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and let $h:V\to T$ be a separated quasi-finite morphism of finite type between Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism, pqf-def-quasifinite, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Here Noetherian means admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. On the small etale sites use constant-$A$ module sheaves and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For a module sheaf $F$, use the proper-support functor of [lem-cbc-proper-support-sheaf-composition]: let $h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!F$ be the subsheaf of $h_*F$ whose sections on an etale $W\to T$ are those sections of $F$ on $V\times_TW$ with support proper over $W$. Support is the closed set of nonzero geometric germs; give it its reduced induced closed subscheme structure [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks, lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme]. Then $h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!$ is exact, and for every compactification $c=(j:V\hookrightarrow\overline V,r:\overline V\to T)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements] there is a canonical natural isomorphism
$$c_h:Rr_*Dj_!\xrightarrow{\sim}D(h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!)$$
on the entire unbounded categories, where the left side is the compact-support candidate [def-amb-etale-compact-support] and $D(h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!)$ applies the exact functor termwise. It is independent of compactification under the proper-refinement comparisons of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Let $B$ be another Noetherian scheme and $e:T\to B$ another separated quasi-finite morphism of finite type. For the composable morphisms $h,e$, these comparisons satisfy
$$c_{eh}\circ\alpha_{e,h}=D(\sigma_{e,h})\circ(c_eD(h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!))\circ(Re_!c_h),$$
where $\alpha_{e,h}:Re_!Rh_!\xrightarrow{\sim}R(eh)_!$ is the compact-support composition of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons] and $\sigma_{e,h}:e^{\mathrm{supp}}_!h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!\xrightarrow{\sim}(eh)^{\mathrm{supp}}_!$ is the identification of sections with proper support of [lem-cbc-proper-support-sheaf-composition]. In particular, for every separated etale finite-type morphism $h:V\to T$ of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism], these assertions apply and $h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!$ is canonically the sum-extension functor of [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension]; under this identification $\sigma_{e,h}$ for etale $e,h$ is the comparison sending a nested summand indexed by lifts $W\to T$, $W\to V$ to the summand indexed by the composite lift $W\to V$. For the identity morphism and its identity compactification, the comparison is the identity, and the same normalization holds for other compactifications under their canonical refinement identifications.

proof.text: A Noetherian scheme in the stated convention is quasi-compact (use its finite affine cover) and locally Noetherian, hence quasi-separated by [lem-weil-pbc-locally-noetherian-quasi-separated]. Apply [thm-pqf-zmt-factorization] to $h$ to obtain $h=pj_0$ with $j_0:V\hookrightarrow V_0$ a quasi-compact open immersion and $p:V_0\to T$ finite. A finite algebra is generated as an algebra by any finite set of module generators, so $p$ is of finite type. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] $V_0$ is Noetherian, and by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-proper] $p$ is proper. Thus $(j_0,p)$ is an admissible compactification. No excellence, finite dimension, or invertibility of the order of $A$ has been used.

proof.text: The support-composition theorem [lem-cbc-proper-support-sheaf-composition], applied to $j_0,p$, gives the natural $A$-linear identification $h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!=p_*j_{0!}$: the proper-support functor is ordinary direct image for $p$, and extension by zero for $j_0$. The functor $j_{0!}$ is exact by [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact]. The finite direct-image theorem [lemma-weil-pbc-finite-direct-image-exact] gives exactness of $p_*$ on underlying abelian sheaves. It also gives exactness for constant-$A$ module sheaves: direct image commutes with forgetting the action by its sectionwise definition [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful] identifies the underlying kernels and cokernels. Vanishing of an underlying kernel/cokernel is vanishing of that module sheaf, so the faithful forgetful functor reflects exactness. Hence $h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!$ is exact.

proof.text: For an arbitrary compactification $c=(j,r)$, its ambient scheme $\overline V$ is Noetherian: $r$ is proper, hence of finite type by definition, and its target $T$ is Noetherian, so [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] applies. The locally Noetherian ambient scheme is quasi-separated by [lem-weil-pbc-locally-noetherian-quasi-separated]. Since $V$ is quasi-compact, [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence] (1) makes $j$ quasi-compact, as required by the compactification category in step 5. For every compactification $c=(j,r)$, the same support-composition theorem identifies $r_*j_!$ with the exact functor $h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!$. Define a comparison in the reverse direction, $\delta_c:D(h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!)\to Rr_*Dj_!$, by the derived-functor unit for $r_*$. Explicitly, on a complex $K$ choose a K-injective resolution $j_!K\to I$; its component is $Q_T(r_*j_!K)\to Q_T(r_*I)$. Resolutions exist by [prop-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions-exist], and [def-amb-etale-compact-support, lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-total-derived] specify this unit and its naturality. Since the source functor is exact, [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization] makes its termwise functor invert quasi-isomorphisms; [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property] therefore descends the natural comparison to the derived category. This construction uses all complexes, without truncations. For the finite compactification $c_0=(j_0,p)$, [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-functor] applied to the exact module functor $p_*$ says that its derived unit is an isomorphism on every complex. Consequently $\delta_{c_0}$ is an isomorphism on the entire unbounded category.

proof.text: Check the normalization under a proper refinement $u:V_1\to V_2$, with $uj_1=j_2$ and $r_2u=r_1$. Write $\beta_u:Rr_{2*}Dj_{2!}\to Rr_{1*}Dj_{1!}$ for its refinement comparison. We claim $\beta_u\delta_{c_2}=\delta_{c_1}$. Represent the input by a K-injective $J$ and resolve $j_{1!}J\to I$. By [lem-amb-unbounded-proper-open-interchange], for the square with left proper edge $\mathrm{id}_V$, right proper edge $u$, top open $j_1$ and bottom open $j_2$, the proper/open map is represented by $j_{2!}J=u_*j_{1!}J\to u_*I$; the equality is the support identification of [lem-cbc-proper-support-sheaf-composition]. Direct image preserves K-injectives by [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact, lem-weil-pbc-right-adjoint-preserves-kinjective]. Thus for a resolution $j_{2!}J\to I_2$, the comparison to $u_*I$ lifts to $I_2\to u_*I$, with the triangle commuting up to homotopy by [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived]. Apply $r_{2*}$ to this triangle. Its top map is $r_{2*}j_{2!}J=r_{1*}j_{1!}J\to r_{1*}I$. The resolution normalization of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition] identifies the other path with $\beta_u\delta_{c_2}$. This proves the claim, first on representatives and then on the derived category by [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property]. The comparisons here are precisely the proper/open refinement comparisons in [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons].

proof.text:
Any compactification $c$ and the finite compactification $c_0$ have a common proper refinement $d\xrightarrow{u}c$, $d\xrightarrow{v}c_0$ by [lem-cbc-compactifiable-cofiltered]. Its ambient scheme is Noetherian by the properness argument of step 3. Put $F_c=Rr_*Dj_!$ for each compactification. The comparisons $\beta_u:F_c\to F_d$ and $\beta_v:F_{c_0}\to F_d$ are isomorphisms with coherent composition by [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Step 4 gives
$$\beta_u\delta_c=\delta_d=\beta_v\delta_{c_0},\qquad
\delta_c=\beta_u^{-1}\beta_v\delta_{c_0}.$$
Thus $\delta_c$ is invertible. Set $c_h^c=\delta_c^{-1}$. For every refinement $w:c_1\to c_2$, inverting $\beta_w\delta_{c_2}=\delta_{c_1}$ gives $c_h^{c_1}\beta_w=c_h^{c_2}$. In the common-refinement diagram this says
$$c_h^c=c_h^{c_0}\beta_v^{-1}\beta_u.$$
The right side equals the fixed map $\delta_c^{-1}$ for every $d,u,v$; the coherent comparison cocycle identifies these expressions with the canonical compactification comparisons. This proves the required independence without any choice of an unspecified isomorphism.

It remains to compare composition maps. Choose the finite compactification of $e$ from step 1. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-compatible-compactification-triangle] to $V\xrightarrow{h}T\xrightarrow{e}B$ and this compactification of $e$; the three schemes are qcqs by step 1. It supplies the tower used in [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Write $T\xrightarrow{i}\overline T\xrightarrow{s}B$, $V\xrightarrow{a}\overline V\xrightarrow{p}\overline T$, and $U=\overline V\times_{\overline T}T$, with $b:U\hookrightarrow\overline V$, $q:U\to T$, $j:V\hookrightarrow U$, $bj=a$ and $pb=iq$. The geometric triangle node states that these are compactifications of $e,h,eh$, with $s,p,q$ proper and $i,a,b,j$ open immersions. Their ambient schemes are Noetherian: $s,p,q$ are of finite type and [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] applies successively over $B$, $\overline T$, and $T$. On sheaves both $e^{\mathrm{supp}}_!h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!$ and $(eh)^{\mathrm{supp}}_!$ identify with $s_*p_*a_!$ through $i_!q_*=p_*b_!$; each identification keeps the section itself, by [lem-cbc-proper-support-sheaf-composition]. In particular $(eh)^{\mathrm{supp}}_!$ is exact, since $e^{\mathrm{supp}}_!$ and $h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!$ are exact, so its $D$ is defined even before making any separate geometric argument about $eh$.

Here is the chain-level check of the comparison. Represent the input by a K-injective $J$ on $V$. Choose resolutions $j_!J\to I$ on $U$ and $b_!I\to M$ on $\overline V$. The complex $q_*I$ is K-injective by [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact, lem-weil-pbc-right-adjoint-preserves-kinjective]. Choose a resolution $i_!q_*I\to L$ on $\overline T$. The proper/open comparison of [lem-amb-unbounded-proper-open-interchange] is the class of $i_!q_*I=p_*b_!I\to p_*M$. Since $p_*M$ is K-injective, this map lifts to $L\to p_*M$, commuting with the resolution map up to homotopy by [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived]. Naturality of $\delta_e$ rewrites $(Re_!\delta_h)\circ(\delta_eD(h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!))$ as $(\delta_eRh_!)\circ D(e^{\mathrm{supp}}_!)(\delta_h)$. Hence the successive units, followed by $\alpha_{e,h}$, are represented by the composite
$$s_*i_!q_*j_!J\longrightarrow s_*i_!q_*I\longrightarrow s_*L\longrightarrow s_*p_*M.$$
Using the lifting triangle and the sheaf equality $i_!q_*=p_*b_!$, this is exactly $s_*p_*b_!j_!J\to s_*p_*M$, induced by $a_!J=b_!j_!J\to b_!I\to M$. By [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact], $b_!$ preserves the quasi-isomorphism $j_!J\to I$, so $a_!J=b_!j_!J\to b_!I\to M$ is a K-injective resolution of $a_!J$. The open-extension composition of [lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition] and the resolution normalization of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition] identify the last map with $\delta_{eh}$, after the section-preserving map $D(\sigma_{e,h})$. Thus
$$\alpha_{e,h}\circ(Re_!\delta_h)\circ(\delta_eD(h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!))=\delta_{eh}\circ D(\sigma_{e,h}).$$
Invert the $\delta$ maps to obtain the displayed equation of the statement. Equality descends by [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property]. For any other choices let $\eta_h,\eta_e,\eta_{eh}$ be their canonical compactification comparisons, and write $\star$ for horizontal composition of natural transformations. The cited refinement compatibility of composition is $\alpha^{\prime}(\eta_e\star\eta_h)=\eta_{eh}\alpha$. Step 4 gives $\delta_h^{\prime}=\eta_h\delta_h$ and the corresponding equalities for $e,eh$. Substitute these equalities, using naturality to move $\eta$ past the whiskered $\delta$ maps, and both sides of the displayed equation are postcomposed with the same $\eta_{eh}$. Hence the equation holds for those choices too; step 5 identifies the comparisons through any common refinement.

proof.text:
Now let $h$ be separated etale of finite type. By [def-weil-etale-morphism] it is unramified, and [lem-weil-pbc-unramified-quasi-finite-at-points] makes it locally quasi-finite. It is quasi-compact because it is of finite type, so [pqf-lem-qf-locqf-qc] makes it quasi-finite. Construct a morphism $h_{\Sigma!}F\to h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!F$ directly from the sum presheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension]. For a lift $t:W\to V$ over $T$, its graph is a section of the separated etale map $V_W\to W$. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits, lem-weil-pbc-separated-base-change, lem-weil-pbc-etale-section-clopen-immersion] that graph is open and closed. Extend a section in the summand indexed by $t$ by zero on the complementary open. Its support is a closed subset of the graph, and hence proper over $W$ by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base-properties], since the graph is isomorphic over $W$ to $W$. Addition and restriction give a map of presheaves into the proper-support sheaf; sheafification gives the claimed natural $A$-linear map.

It is an isomorphism on stalks. Indeed [lem-cbc-proper-support-geometric-stalk] identifies the target stalk at $\bar t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$ with $H^0_c(V_{\bar t},F|_{V_{\bar t}})$. The geometric fibre is separated etale over $\Omega$; by [sbc-lem-etale-over-normal] applied to the integral normal scheme $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ it is a disjoint union of copies of $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$. This union is finite: $h$ is quasi-compact and quasi-compactness is preserved under base change by [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence], so its cover by these disjoint open points has a finite subcover. A finite union of such points is finite over $\Omega$ (on rings it is the finite free algebra $\Omega^n$), hence proper by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-proper]; every closed support is proper by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base-properties]. Sections are the finite product of the sections on the points by the sheaf axiom, and [lem-weil-pbc-geometric-point-pullback-stalk, lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-stalk-germ] identify each with $F_{\bar v}$. Thus the target stalk is $\bigoplus_{h\bar v=\bar t}F_{\bar v}$. Under the generator formula in [lem-amb-etale-sum-stalks], the source-to-target map sends a germ in the summand of $t$ to the same germ in the summand of $t\bar w$. It is the identity on these finite sums. Therefore it is an isomorphism by [lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative]; forgetting scalars detects isomorphisms by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful].

proof.text: For composable separated etale $V\xrightarrow{h}T\xrightarrow{e}B$, the sheaf map $\sigma_{e,h}$ keeps the section on $V\times_BW$ unchanged by [lem-cbc-proper-support-sheaf-composition]. A generator with a lift $v:W\to T$ and a lift $w:W\to V$ satisfying $hw=v$ first extends its section along the graph of $w$ over $T$, then along the graph of $v$ over $B$. This is its extension by zero along the graph of $w$ over $B$: its restriction there is the original section and its restriction to the complementary open is zero in both constructions. The sheaf axiom on that clopen decomposition proves equality of the two sections. Finite sums and sheafification prove that $\sigma_{e,h}$ is exactly the stated nested-summand comparison. For the identity morphism, the only lift over each test object is its structural map, so the same construction is the identity. For its identity compactification, the derived unit $\delta$ is also the identity, choosing the exact identity functor as its own derived functor with identity unit, as permitted by [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-functor]. Step 4 gives the identical normalization after comparison with any other compactification.
